behavior: Typed Start and End select a shared source range. Zero End follows the available source end. Current Position and Length use crop-relative time.
A paused seek to the maximum keeps the exact control position and displays the last in-range image. Hard-loop frame intervals are half-open source PTS windows on the shared clock.
Crop edits preserve the current source coordinate when possible and invalidate old decode windows. Stop and Matrix Play from Start return to the crop start.

Shorter channels hold their last image. The blend duration is limited by the shortest known crop intersection. A replacement ending at or before Start gives a zero-length unavailable crop while retaining the authored endpoints.
